verdict.rationale: Weave runs headlessly by design. It is a code-first SDK: `weave.init()` and `@weave.op` handle tracing, and code-defined `Evaluation` objects test against repeatable cases to catch regressions. It also offers a REST Service API with API-key bearer auth and a full OpenAPI spec, so it can be driven from scripts or CI without the UI. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions examples or failing a build on evaluation regressions), a Weave-specific CLI (the documented CLI is the W&B Models CLI), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
